name: Fluorescent brightener 378
description: Fluorescent Brightener 378 (CAS 40470-68-6 ), commercially known as CBS-127, is a stilbene-based optical brightening agent used to enhance the perceived whiteness and brightness of substrates. By absorbing UV light and re-emitting it as visible blue fluorescence, it counteracts yellowing in finished materials without altering their base formulation during the manufacturing process. In plastics and polymer processing, CBS-127 is incorporated into polyolefins, PET, and engineering resins to deliver high-whiteness aesthetics in packaging films, molded parts, and synthetic fibers. Paper and board manufacturers apply it during coating or surface sizing to meet brightness specifications required by premium print and packaging grades for commercial use. Textile producers use it in finishing baths for synthetic fabrics where conventional washing-based brighteners are unsuitable. Coating and adhesive formulators add it to white and near-white systems. This additive is essential where long-term brightness retention under UV exposure is a commercial requirement. It is supplied as a fine yellow-green powder with defined fluorescence intensity. Technical and industrial grades are the standard market offering, with specifications typically covering active content, melting point range, and solvent compatibility for various industrial applications. Packaging is available in kilogram quantities through to bulk bags depending on application volume. This ensures flexibility for both small-scale testing and large-scale industrial production needs.
